definitions.short: the kind (maternal) bird , i.e. a stork
definitions.full: H2624. chasidah I. חֲסִידָה noun feminine stork (so called as kind and affectionate to its young) — Lev 11:19 = Deut 14:18 ; Psa 104:17 ; Jer 8:7 ; Zech 5:9 .
